integrity: The theorem and its quantitative constants are supported by the explicit Gaussian coefficient optimization, a source-checked flag contraction, exact planar trapezoid construction, and a general shrinking-corner sharpness limit. Computational tests are corroborating rather than a proof; prior literature is cited without claims of independent certification.
limitations: Full face-distance admissibility is required. For dimensions at least three and heights strictly between one and the square root of the dimension, optimality is established for the ordered-Gaussian orthoscheme comparison, not for arbitrary geometric facets. No global equality classification for all unit-height facets is asserted. Historical priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp facet-height angular profiles under Vaaler face-distance constraints
